levels.description: Can only be deployed on the edges of the map or next to other [River] tiles; increases the effect of other surrounding [Terrain] tiles; when there are ground tiles in the 4 adjacent tiles, irrigates the soil, creating [Loam]; when skill is activated, generates a <@ba.enemy>Diver</> (grants <@ba.drop>Sniper Advancement Tokens</> and <@ba.drop>Specialist Advancement Tokens</> once defeated) or a <@ba.enemy>Dockworker</> (grants <@ba.drop>Guard Advancement Tokens</> and <@ba.drop>Vanguard Advancement Tokens</> once defeated)
